metadata.label: Institution-associated Reddit discussions
metadata.method: VADER 3.3.2 on post titles; Positive ≥ 0.05, Negative ≤ −0.05, otherwise Neutral.
metadata.privacy: Aggregate and de-identified. No usernames, IDs, titles, excerpts, or direct post URLs are included.
metadata.trendWarning: The combined monthly series changes source composition in July 2025 when r/gradadmissions begins. Interpret the trend descriptively; source-type monthly aggregates were not included in the public package.

programmes.warning: Coverage is insufficient for institution-to-institution comparison.
programmes.interpretation: Institution-associated Reddit discussions; exploratory community evidence, not programme-quality evidence.
